serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: InEight Document is construction document control software that is uniquely suited to the demands of complex construction due to its configurability and tracking capabilities. This SaaS offering for the US Government uses a multi-tenant Government-Only cloud computing environment. It is available to public, federal, state, local, and tribal governments, as well as research institutions, federal contractors, and government contractors.
